name: nft-policy-chain-policy-drop-sub-counts
description: chain-policy-drop with a chain that counts the peer without reaching a verdict
setup: nft add chain inet f out "{ type filter hook output priority 0; policy accept; }"
nft add chain inet f sub
nft add rule inet f sub ip daddr 10.5.5.2 counter

action.spec: nft add chain inet f out "{ type filter hook output priority 0; policy drop; }"
